extends: results/exp05_dose/manifest.json (unchanged; its 9 primary contrasts keep their own Holm family)
why: human request on 2026-09-30: the same dose design on more models, for breadth (other labs and architectures). Written while the pre-registered run was generating Qwen3-32B, before any extension row was generated.

design.same_as_manifest: items, opener rules, doses, conditions, prompts, seeds, caps, abort rule, graded text and scoring of manifest.json

openings.Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8: own no-constraint trace from exp05's requests_base_Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8.jsonl
openings.GLM-4.7-Flash: own no-constraint trace from exp05's requests_base_GLM-4.7-Flash.jsonl

reference_points.Gemma-4-31B-FP8: exp04's no-prefill rows (d0) and generic one-sentence arms
reference_points.Qwen3.5-9B: exp04's no-prefill rows (d0) and generic one-sentence arms
reference_points.Gemma-4-12B: exp04's no-prefill rows (d0) and generic one-sentence arms
reference_points.Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8: d0 only: requests_base_<model>.jsonl's opener-rule rows (baseline prompt; exp04 requests_none ids); no generic-sentence arm
reference_points.GLM-4.7-Flash: d0 only: requests_base_<model>.jsonl's opener-rule rows (baseline prompt; exp04 requests_none ids); no generic-sentence arm

design.new_model_procedure: 1) generate requests_base_<model>.jsonl; 2) gate (cfg.EXP05_BASE_GATE, on its no-constraint traces): closed share >= 0.90, median reasoning tokens >= 100, non-empty answer share >= 0.80; if it fails, the model is dropped and reported; 3) write requests_<model>.jsonl with cc_exp05.dose_rows (same code as the pre-registered models), recorded in requests_record_<model>.json; 4) generate it

analysis.family: R_d1, R_d3, R_trend per extension model, Holm over those 15 contrasts (separate from the pre-registered 9)
analysis.runs: 'extension_a' after Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 (every model but GLM-4.7-Flash), 'extension' after GLM-4.7-Flash (all models); both beside the pre-registered 'main' run, which they do not replace
analysis.status: exploratory breadth; the pre-registered conclusions rest on the 3 models of manifest.json

confounds_and_checks: new models: no exp04 generic-sentence arm and no exp03/exp04 history; their d0 is from the same request ids as the other models' d0
Gemma 4: every thinking request starts with '<|channel>thought\n' (exp04's adapter)
GLM-4.7-Flash: first use of its chat format in this repo (template ends '<|assistant|><think>'); bf16 weights; card sampling T 1.0, top_p 0.95 (no top_k); presence_penalty 0 as for every family here
Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8: the qwen3.6 family's settings (card thinking settings with presence_penalty 0, the human choice of 2026-09-29 for Qwen3.5/3.6)

models differ in precision (FP8 checkpoints for Gemma-4-31B and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, bf16 for Gemma-4-12B, Qwen3.5-9B, GLM-4.7-Flash); every model's arms share its own precision, so within-model contrasts are matched
hardware: 1x H200 141 GB, TP 1, vLLM 0.30.0 streaming engine (exp04's), after the pre-registered run
